remarks: VRP Pricing Seller will consider offers from $40,000 to $89,900 or higher. Set in an exceptional location just steps from the Niagara Falls State Park & within walking distance to downtown, the tourism district, restaurants, shops, & attractions, this property offers the rare opportunity to enjoy the sights & sounds of one of the world's most iconic destinations. With its close proximity to the water, the park, and the heart of the city, this home presents outstanding potential for the buyer with a vision. Cash Buyers Only! Calling all Investors, flippers and visionaries who want to build equity quick and have a place to call home! This property requires substantial renovations but offers exceptional upside in one of the most sought-after locations in the City of Niagara Falls. Situated within the City's approved Short-Term Rental, (AirBnB) district, the property is within walking distance of Niagara Falls State Park, Rainbow Bridge to Canada, Seneca Niagara Casino, restaurants, entertainment, and the tourism district. It is also near the proposed $1.5 billion downtown development project. Potential uses include a short-term rental, renovation and resale, or a long-term hold. Opportunities in this area are limited. This three-bedroom, one bath home offers a classic layout with great potential for renovation. The first floor features a welcoming entrance hallway, a spacious living room, a formal dining room, and a kitchen. The second floor includes a three bedrooms and one full bath. A full basement adds valuable storage and additional possibilities. With a traditional floor plan and solid footprint, this property presents and excellent opportunity for investors or buyers looking to create value and bring new life to a well-designed home. Much sought after off street parking available adds to the value. Opportunities this close to Niagara Falls State Park are limited, and as the area continues to evolve, properties in this corridor may become increasingly valuable. Buy, now, improve over time, and position yourself to benefit from the upside this location may offer. Strictly "as is" condition.
